tasks.label: Chezmoi: Apply, Commit, and Push
tasks.command: chezmoi apply --verbose && git -C /home/brschneider/.local/share/chezmoi add -A && (git -C /home/brschneider/.local/share/chezmoi diff --cached --quiet || git -C /home/brschneider/.local/share/chezmoi commit -m "Update dotfiles: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')") && git -C /home/brschneider/.local/share/chezmoi push
